lines: Seat 1 chooses Warbrand: at the end, 1 point per rival tile taken, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Weaver: at the end, 1 point per 2 tiles in your largest connected group beyond the first 2, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Wild tile at (0, 1) (yields 3) for 4 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Steady tile at (1, -2) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (2, -2) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (-1, 2) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (0, -1) (yields 1).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Shifting tile at (0, -1) (yields 1) for 2 mana.
A tie for the Shifting tile at (-1, 2) (yields 3) at 2 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 2 gets the Shifting tile at (-1, 2) (yields 3) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Shifting tile at (-2, 0) (yields 1) for free.
